entries.title: A live map on your dashboard
items: A new live map widget follows your drive with turn-by-turn directions—free for 24 hours, then part of Speedometer Pro
Add your own photos to your dashboard—pick a photo frame, instant print or round photo from your gallery or camera
Your info display is now two widgets you can place on their own: date & time, and your phone's meters

entries.title: Split the info display in two
items: Add the date and time, and your phone's status meters, as two separate pieces in any style.
A New layout card now sits at the end of the layouts — tap it to build your own, starting from the current layout or from scratch.

entries.title: Every style draws every gauge
items: Every style now draws the full set of gauges — dials, HUD arcs, Wi-Fi rings, the analog clock and the date — in its own colours.

entries.title: Styles show their full look
items: Styles that rearrange a gauge now show its full look — background, readouts and warning lamps — when you try them in the browser

entries.title: Layouts that fit your screen
items: Styles now come with a landscape layout, and the preview shows the arrangement that fits your screen.
When a style is updated, its newest version now shows in your browser.

entries.title: Screens now use the whole height
items: Signed-in players without a birth year on their VHub account can now add it in one step, so friends and names work.
Screens now use the whole height: no more empty band at the bottom.
Smoother wallpaper and previews, and fixes for rare crashes when going back after saving a layout and during purchases.

entries.title: Help tickets read like a chat
items: Fixed a crash on some phones when the mobile signal could not be read.
Help tickets now read like a chat, with a clear status badge and your screenshots right in the thread.

entries.title: One smooth motion everywhere
items: Cards, menus and previews now open and close with one smooth motion everywhere in the app.
If a layout you shared is taken off the market, you now see the moderator's note saying why.

entries.title: Preview the HUD look
items: Horizon, Glass, Pulse and Vector now have an Original | HUD switch on their page: see each one's HUD look before you drive, and switch back with one tap.

entries.title: See your speed on the windscreen
items: HUD mode puts your speed on the windscreen — and it's now front and centre on your home screen and in Styles.
Share a look as a QR code or link that opens its style and layout straight in the app.
In the layout builder, drag the layers to change which gauges sit in front.

entries.title: New HUD mode
items: New: HUD mode. Lay your phone flat on the dashboard and see your speed on the windscreen, in Horizon (free), Glass, Pulse or Vector, with four layouts, the clock, trip, heading and your own speed warning. Open it from Home, the HUD mode tile, the app icon, or by itself when your car connects.
The whole app is now in Greek — every screen, gauge and widget — when your phone is set to Greek.
Report a problem or share an idea from Settings — and read our reply right in the app.

New: HUD mode. Lay your phone flat on the dashboard and see your speed on the windscreen, in Horizon (free), Glass, Pulse or Vector, with four layouts, the clock, trip, heading and your own speed warning. Open it from Home, the HUD mode tile, the app icon, or by itself when your car connects.

entries.title: Report a problem or an idea
items: Report a problem or share an idea from Settings, add up to 3 screenshots, and follow our replies
Turn on News by email to get our updates, and unsubscribe anytime with one tap

entries.title: Now available in Greek
items: Set your phone's language to Greek and the whole app — screens, gauges, widget captions and messages — now shows in Greek; any other language stays in English.

entries.title: Cleaner layouts and new designs
items: We reviewed every layout: cluttered and unbalanced ones are gone, and the rest are now symmetrical, with real gauges around the main dial.
Your music player now takes on each style's own look, instead of the same plain card everywhere.
Gauges, clocks and music controls now stay readable on whatever background they sit on.

entries.title: Build your own layout
items: Build your own layout: add, move, resize, lock and stack any widget, preview it in any style, then save and use it.
Every style gets 25 new widgets, including trip, odometer, 0–100, G-force, weather, moon, steps, music controls and a second clock.
Browse layouts other people have made, preview any in your own style, then use, rate, share or report them — and publish your own.

entries.title: Calls and messages no longer empty
items: The Calls and messages gauge now shows a sample song and counts in every style you try, instead of looking empty.

entries.title: Settings apply to every style
items: Changing the speed unit, clock or seconds now updates every style, including ones you've customized.
When you sign in, your settings follow you between the browser and the app.

entries.title: Cleaner gauges in every style
items: Your clock, speed and other readings now shrink to fit instead of being cut off
In Glass Cockpit and Vintage, the frame no longer cuts across the dials
Song titles and event text no longer appear too large

entries.title: Three new Harbour looks
items: The Harbour style has been redesigned with three new looks — Yacht, Regatta and Porthole — each in a Bridge and a Helm layout
You can now browse shared layouts on the page and open any one — or a shared link — to try it in any style

entries.title: 17 new styles
items: 17 new styles to choose from — from chrome car dials to neon heads-up displays and race clusters
Customize every style: change its colours, background and glow, and drag, resize and arrange the gauges into your own layout
A redesigned app with live previews of every style

entries.title: Try it in your browser
items: The real wallpaper runs on this site, live in a phone, with nothing to install.
Pick a style and its layout, change its settings, and tap the big gauge to switch what it shows.
GPS speed shows how fast you're going once you allow your browser's location.

entries.title: Rebuilt, and out on Google Play
items: Your home screen as a car dashboard, rebuilt from the 2016 original.
The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed: tap it, or use the Quick Settings tile, to switch.
Browse designs with live previews; Future shows your music, missed calls and messages.
